NETWORK_PRESENCE.NAME: Network presence
NETWORK_PRESENCE.DESCRIPTION: Detects who is at home from the phones connected to the local network

SUBNETS.NAME: Networks
SUBNETS.DESCRIPTION: Networks to sweep in CIDR notation, comma separated (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24). Empty = the networks of the server's interfaces

POLL.NAME: Polling interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: How often the known phones are probed

AWAY_TIMEOUT.NAME: Away after [min]
AWAY_TIMEOUT.DESCRIPTION: A phone counts as away when it was not seen for this long. Phones in standby drop off the network for minutes, keep it at 10 or more

FULL_SCAN.NAME: Full sweep every [min]
FULL_SCAN.DESCRIPTION: How often every address of the networks is probed to find phones that got a new address

ANYONE_HOME.NAME: Anyone home
ANYONE_HOME.DESCRIPTION: True while at least one person is home

PERSON.NAME: Person
PERSON.DESCRIPTION: A person (user) and the phones that belong to them

SCAN.NAME: Find phones
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the devices currently on the network that are not assigned yet. Add a device to assign it to this person

HOME.NAME: Home
HOME.DESCRIPTION: True while one of the person's phones is connected

LAST_SEEN.NAME: Last seen
LAST_SEEN.DESCRIPTION: When one of the phones was last seen on the network

DEVICES_HOME.NAME: Phones connected
DEVICES_HOME.DESCRIPTION: Number of the person's phones on the network

DEVICE.NAME: Phone
DEVICE.DESCRIPTION: A phone or other device, identified by its MAC address

MAC.NAME: MAC address
MAC.DESCRIPTION: Wi-Fi MAC address. Phones use a private address per network: take the one shown for your home Wi-Fi, and switch off address rotation

CONNECTED.NAME: Connected
CONNECTED.DESCRIPTION: True while the device was seen within the away timeout

LAST_SEEN.NAME: Last seen
LAST_SEEN.DESCRIPTION: When the device was last seen on the network
